runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, blocked off when going for run 600m out, weakened and gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。六百米處在取位時受困。最後二百米轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Pressed leader against rail, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 追迫領放馬，走內欄。直路早段加速，三百米處取得領先。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed by winner 75m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。直路初率先加速，取得領先。七十五米處被頭馬超越。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2-1/2L back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked approaching 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段保持佳勢，趨近一百五十米處時未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, carried out 450M, very wide turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Made running, pressed on 400m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 帶頭競跑。四百米處受催策。二百米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W6W) Held up, last and wide into home straight, stayed on final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W6W) 留後。入直路時居包尾位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away awkwardly, quickly recovered to be 3rd tucked in the trail, had difficulty obtaining clear passage over final stages, unable to be fully tested, excusable.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，迅速恢復走勢，居第三位，緊隨對手。末段難以望空。未能全力施為。落敗情有可原。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L, easy lead to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed near 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，領先一又四分一馬位。直路彎前從容領放。直路早段保持佳勢。接近二百米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, driven along to chase leaders 500m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Dropped in from wide draw, keen mid-race, pushed along over 500m out, no response to pressure, eased when well held 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。中段搶口。五百米處受推策。對催策毫無反應，二百米處落後甚遠時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched to chase leaders 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處轉換跑線以追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, made minor headway in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled midfield one off, showed some progress final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W4W) Made contact with the right side of its starting gate on jumping, taken back to race at rear on the inside, angled out 500M, 9 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W4W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂右側，留居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後九個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on outer, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat handy, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居前列。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Mid-field, unable to quicken under pressure over 300m out, stayed on, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。三百米處在催策下未能加速。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sluggish start, rear of mid-field, no real impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置。受催策，但未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, taken wider 500m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。五百米處被帶出較外疊。直路初受催策，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden along to hold position 700m out, good headway up rail final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處受催策以保持位置。最後二百米沿欄追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Lacked early pace and had to settle further back in the field along the outside fence, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段欠缺前速，居後列，走外欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked pace, challenged 200m out, soon hung right, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處展開挑戰。瞬即內閃。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced in rear after bumped leaving stalls, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Sat behind midfield, was taken wider near the 900M, switched out entering the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置。接近九百米處時被帶出較外疊。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Lifted front feet on jumping and away tardily, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight, eased final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 躍出時一對前腳並舉，出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。最後一百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘後受催策以跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Outpaced in rear, hung in and lost balance 900m out, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，未能跟上步速。九百米處內閃及失去平衡。直路初受催策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, made good progress thereafter to take 2nd. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後約五個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路早段未能望空，趨近二百米處時望空，其後追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat midfield, held up at the top of the Straight, no clear run over the final 50M, could not be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。直路初受困。最後五十米未能望空。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W5W) Settled worse than midfield, raced wide, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W5W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, driven along 600m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策。末段以佳勢上前，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, held up last, ridden along and outpaced middle stages, left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，留居包尾位置。中段受催策，但未能跟上步速。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, found rail approaching 700M, saved ground on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。趨近七百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position and taken widest on bend, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置，移出最外疊。遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Out with rest, positioned 2 wide better than midfield, angled out approaching 650M, 3 wide turning in, showed good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on well to hold off the challengers late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。趨近六百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時走第三疊。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處帶頭。末段保持佳勢，力拒對手挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W5W) Slowly into stride and shuffled back, detached and pushed along widest 500m out, late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W5W) 展步緩慢，墮後。被拋離，五百米處受推策，走最外疊。末段追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Awkward start, three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat handy, raced wide, gave ground quickly near 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。接近三百米處時迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled within 3L of pace in 5th, commenced move entering straight but faded under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。入直路時開始上前，但最後三百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Began awkwardly and sat prominent outside the leader, overraced in the early stages, failed to sustain his run and compounded rapidly at the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居領放馬外側位置。早段搶口。後勁不繼。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled handy, lay in in the Straight, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。直路上內閃。對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, gave ground entering the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。入直路時墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W5W) Settled midfield 3 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, kept on same pace until no clear run final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。保持同速，直至最後五十米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W4W) Sat 4 wide no cover midfield, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 3/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Crowded start, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, peaked on run 500M, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。五百米處未能再增速。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Prominent early, tracking leaders halfway, struggling to hold position final bend, soon weakened.
(Sustained a small abrasion to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small abrasion to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W) 早段居前列，半程時跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎難以保持位置，瞬即轉弱。
（右前腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Shifted out and heavily bumped out of stalls, disputed lead 700m out, ridden top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及與對手互相大力碰撞。七百米處爭奪領先。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前，帶頭。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on outer, 5 lengths or so back in the middle stages, finished off very strongly to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。中段落後約五個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 600m out, dropped away in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped well, taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bounded as stalls opened, rail position in rear of mid-field, headway halfway out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 開閘時向上跳躍，居中間之後位置，走內欄。半程時上前。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 900M, 2 lengths or so back on turn, angled out 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened final 200M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。接近九百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎落後約兩個馬位。五百米處向外移出。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。在催策下反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W3W4W) Moderately away from a wide draw, unable to slot in, trapped wide with no cover, 2 lengths or so back, dropped towards rear after passing 550M, emptied early in straight, eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W3W4W) 自外檔出閘普通，未能切入內疊，落後約兩個馬位，走外疊，沒有遮擋。跑過五百五十米處後墮居後列。直路早段力竭，其後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Shifted out and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, forced to steady on heels on bend, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎被迫收慢避開對手的後蹄，大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，落後約六個馬位，走內疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat rear, angled out passing 600M, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居後列。跑過六百米處時向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Bumped start, positioned 3 wide, 1-1/2L back, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked 450M, weakened and eased early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，落後一個半馬位，走第三疊，大部分途程沒有遮擋。四百五十米處未能再增速。直路初轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat in front of midfield, weakened passing 250M, gave ground quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱，迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, hung out in the Home Straight, failed to run out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路上外閃，未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, bumped near 600M, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時發生碰撞。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out and made contact near 450M, no clear run until approaching final 100M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。接近四百五十米處時向外移出及發生觸碰。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat on pace, weakened slightly passing the 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列。跑過二百五十米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield early, dropped to midfield near 800M, 5 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近八百米處時墮居中間位置。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Raced prominently, keen, lost place turning into home straight, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，搶口。轉入直路時失位，轉弱。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Circus Maximus from Double Expresso, a daughter of Shamexpress. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. The fellow was given five trials in Hong Kong for one placing. He sat midfield and finished third under pressure, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on May 29. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fifth under pressure, beaten by 3Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 7. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「大競賽場」(Circus Maximus)之後，為此父系首匹子嗣在港上陣，生母出自「特快班車」(Shamexpress)。抵港後五次試閘一次上名。5月29日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。最近9月7日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第五名，落後頭馬三個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat off midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 3 wide towards rear, 7 lengths back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 自第十檔出閘後留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, perfectly placed to challenge over 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走第三疊。三百米處居絕佳位置以展開挑戰，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Sat off pace 2 wide, gave ground final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, travelled up smoothly top of the Straight, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路初走勢暢順。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) In last few early stages, forced to check 900M out before pulling forward wide around home bend, fought on under pressure from just over 2L back into straight until finding no extra close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 早段居最後數位內。九百米處被迫勒避。轉直路彎時上前，走外疊。入直路時落後稍逾兩個馬位，在催策下力拼，直至接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Started well from wide draw and across to make running, came under pressure 200m out, challenged by runner-up final 100m, responded and always holding that rival final 50m despite edging left.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入領放。二百米處受催策。最後一百米受亞軍馬匹挑戰。最後五十米雖然向外斜跑，但對催策交出反應，一直力拒該匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, angled out after passing 400M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 留居後列，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W) Lifted front feet on jumping, raced prominently but trapped wide early, slightly taken back after passing 1000M, raced 3 wide better than midfield on turn, challenged the leader early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W) 躍出時一對前腳並舉，早段居前列，但走外疊。跑過一千米處後略為留後。直路彎居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路初挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Well back dropping to tail-end inside the 600m, made no impression thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 遙居於後。六百米處墮居包尾位置，其後毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Slowly away, driven along and outpaced early stages, still well held from top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘緩慢。早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。直路初仍遙遙落後。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙及與對手互相觸碰，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover near midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier, positioned one-out-one-back rounding home bend, came under pressure upon straightening but faded inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，受催策上前。轉直路彎時落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時受催策，但最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Behind after badly hampered leaving stalls, still in last place and plenty to do turning into home straight, stayed on final 300m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時嚴重受阻礙，其後居後列。轉入直路時仍居包尾位置，落後甚遠，最後三百米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Clean jump, raced 2 wide better than midfield, a length or so back turning in, took the lead approaching 200M, peaked and headed 150M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, no daylight early in straight, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路初未能望空。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Led, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 領放。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away awkwardly and settled prominent early, overraced early stages, lacked a finishing effort over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，早段居前列，搶口。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W4W) Crowded at start, soon recovered to 9th just worse than midfield, switched wide into home straight, made modest progress past well-beaten ones inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間稍後的第九位。入直路時移出外疊。最後一百五十米略為追前，超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat last, no clear run top of the Straight, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居包尾位置。直路初未能望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W3W) Soon taken well behind from the widest barrier, commenced move inside the 600M to be 3-wide rounding home bend, kept on at the one pace in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。六百米處開始發力。轉直路彎時走第三疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, switched for clear run 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。四百米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, hung in in the Straight (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。直路上內閃。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, well placed and every chance from 400m out, unable to quicken, gave ground final 100m.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起居好位，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段未能加速，最後一百米墮退。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Ridden forward after moderate start to within 2L of pace in 3rd or 4th, switched off rail for a run shortly after straightening but unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居第三或第四位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位。入直路後不久移離內欄以取位，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Prominent early from a low draw, gradually drifted backward to midfield approaching first turn, baulked for a run just inside the 400M, quickened well to hit the front over 100M out only to be collared final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 自內檔出閘，早段居前列。趨近首個彎位時逐漸墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處後受困。末段加速良佳，一百米處取得領先，僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Moderate start, gradually recovered to midfield in 8th or 7th on rail, improved to 6th some 4L back on home bend, fought on under pressure to reach 2nd 100M out but without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步一般，其後逐漸恢復走勢，居中間第七或第八位，走內欄。直路彎推進至第六位，落後約四個馬位。在催策下力拼，一百米處進佔第二位，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Average to begin, raced in 2nd, 3/4L back turning in, hard ridden from 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 出閘一般，居第二位。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。自三百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear on the rail, saved ground on the turn, kept on fairly in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped at start, waited with in rear, hampered top of home straight, ran on strongly but too late.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞。居後列，留力候上。直路初受阻礙。後勁凌厲但為時已晚。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled reasonably well, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide midfield, nothing extra. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled well back from the widest draw and waited with, became last 900M out rounding home bend, shifted wider into straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居後列，留力候上。九百米處轉直路彎時居包尾位置。入直路時移出較外疊。末段沿跑道中央在催策下追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 2 wide on very wide into straight, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 留居後列，走內疊。中段搶口，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Began only fairly from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 450M, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, hampered near 200M, made minor progress final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能望空。接近二百米處時受阻礙。最後一百米略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared near 250M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能望空，接近二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, a bit closer in the middle stages, angled out approaching 500M, 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。中段略為追近。趨近五百米處時向外移出。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Raced midfield 2 wide, made good progress in the Straight, just missed 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上追前甚多，僅失去季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Settled midfield on the rail, held up in the Straight, unable to be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上受困，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven 450m out, unable to pick up for pressure, eased when detached 150m out.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。四百五十米處受催策，但未能加速。 一百五十米處被拋離時收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W3W) Settled worse than midfield, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace, three wide, struggling to quicken when tight for room 300m out, weakened after.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。三百米處在受緊迫之際難以加速。其後轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W5W) Sluggish start, three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W5W) 起步緩慢，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) A fraction slow away, sat a tad worse than midfield hugging the rail, failed to muster speed, quickly beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。末段未能加速，迅速洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced behind midfield on rail, 3 lengths back on turn, no clear run early in straight, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎落後三個馬位。直路早段未能望空，其後追前頗多，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Sat at the rear, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Bumped start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, last turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide better than midfield, a length back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, 2 wide on turn, angled out after passing 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時被觸碰，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。直路彎走第二疊，跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along into home straight, lost balance 200m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策。二百米處失去平衡。從未能與領先馬匹一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Sat rear, switched out at the Turn, showed some dash over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。末段略為加速上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, forced to steady 1000m out, under pressure 500m out, ran on well to lead close home in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一千米處被迫收慢。五百米處受催策。走勢良佳，接近終點時在多駒幾乎齊過終點下率先衝線。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, mid division, keen middle stages, driven along 500m out, ran on well final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置。中段搶口。五百米處受催策。最後二百米以佳勢上前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, rail position in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, not best of runs final 200m but ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路早段空位不足。最後二百米未能完全望空，但走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Sat towards rear, held up at the Turn, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居後列。直路彎受困。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Chased leader, switched for clear run final bend, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 追趕領放馬。直路彎轉換跑線以望空。直路早段加速，二百米處取得領先。接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress early in straight, no clear run final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in last few 3-wide with cover, widest runner turning in for home, ran on steadily under pressure down the centre of the straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時走最外疊。直路上受催策，在跑道中央以穩勢上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Mid-division, three wide, pushed along halfway and struggling to hold position, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。半程時受推策，難以保持位置，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Prominent early, caught behind weakening runner from halfway and shuffled back to rear by top of home straight, no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段居前列。自半程起在轉弱的對手之後受困，直路初前墮居後列。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W4W) Held up, pushed along 300m out and no impression, never out of rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W4W) 留後。三百米處受推策，毫無表現。從未超越後列。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly behind midfield on rail, saved ground throughout, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat last, made some minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on at the one pace under pressure final 200m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持同速，從未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled fairly, crowded near the 150M, found nothing thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。接近一百五十米處時受擠迫。其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat at the rear, no clear running until final furlong, made good late ground before held up in the concluding stages. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。末段追前甚多，其後受困。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, under pressure 550m out, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。五百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled fairly, weakened notably in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 在力策下取得領先，走勢一般。直路上顯著轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 600m out, one paced under pressure, impeded 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起難以保持位置。在催策下保持同速。一百米處受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, shared lead turning in, peaked 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時並排領先。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier, obtained rails run in front 1000M out setting a steady pace, kicked some 2L clear on straightening but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M and collared close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入內欄，一千米處取得領先，以平穩步速領放。入直路時加速帶離約兩個馬位，但最後一百米後勁不繼，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leader, under pressure to chase leader 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。四百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, followed winner through 300m out, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly, sat a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) In touch with leaders, hampered 600m out, soon struggling and lost place, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受阻礙。瞬即掙扎上前，失位。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Dropped back to the rear with the speed underneath, severely checked near the 900M and soon got slightly detached from the field, swung home the widest, made no impression in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 在賽事步速甚快下墮居後列。接近九百米處時大力勒避，瞬即被馬群稍為拋離。直路彎走最外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) In rear after sluggish start, still in rear top of home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，居尾列。直路初仍居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W1W) Tracked leaders, struggled to hold position from 700m out, severely checked 500m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自七百米處起難以保持位置。五百米處大力勒避，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W2W) Always well behind and never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W2W) 沿途遙居於後。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Waited with in rear, keen middle stages, checked 700m out, outpaced final bend, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。中段搶口。七百米處勒避。直路彎未能跟上步速。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Awkward start and lost ground, held up last, driven along and outpaced middle stages, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，留居包尾位置。中段受催策，但未能跟上步速。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield, made some progress under whip, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。在鞭策下略為追前。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Mid-field, once paced under pressure, late gains but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。末段追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out after passing 400M, 4 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Sat midfield 3 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W3W) Settled behind midfield, traveled smoothly, made steady progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。走勢暢順。穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Sat towards rear, switched out entering the Straight, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。入直路時向外移出。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat towards the rear, no clear run early part of the Straight, stayed on well once in the clear. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。直路早段未能望空。末段望空後隨即保持佳勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Settled at the rear, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居後列。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along on bend to chase leaders, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎受推策以追趕領先馬匹。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 3 wide at rear, very wide into straight, made minor progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空，二百米處望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat at the rear, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居後列。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Fast into stride, raced prominently on the inside, allowed the rival to cross near 500M, a length or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展步迅速，居前列，走內疊。接近五百米處時讓對手過頭，入直路時落後約一個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position 800m out, ran on well in home straight but always held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。八百米處在催策下保持位置。直路上以佳勢上前，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, minor progress made, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。略為上前。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Crowded start, unable to slot in, trapped wide in midfield on the outside, slightly taken back approaching 700M, found cover near 650M, 6-1/2L back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 起步時受擠迫，未能切入，居中間位置，走外疊。趨近七百米處時稍為留後。接近六百五十米處時取得遮擋。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, ran on well to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至二百五十米處。末段以佳勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Mid-division, short of room when looking to improve from 400m out, stayed on once clear, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起在嘗試推進之際空位不足。望空後保持走勢，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped out of stalls, waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，留力後上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Slow to begin, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, made good progress final 200M to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。最後二百米追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, shifted right in home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路上向內斜跑。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Ridden forward from moderate start to within 2L of pace along the rail, shifted slightly further back to share 4th from 900M out, weakened out of contention inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走內欄。其後再略為墮後，自九百米處起並列第四位。最後三百米轉弱，再無爭勝之力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat towards the rear, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled midfield, raced wide with cover, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊，有遮擋。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, made steady ground late (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段穩步上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Mid division, had to wait for run turning into home straight, short of room 400m out to 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。四百米處至一百米處空位不足。際遇欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, had to wait for run top of home straight, switched wide for clear run 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列。直路初須等待空位出現。一百米處移出外疊以望空。敗在欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Held up last, race keenly throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。沿途搶口。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W6W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W6W) 留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded and checked leaving stalls, in rear, rail position throughout, unable to quicken in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫及勒避。沿途居後列，走內欄。直路上未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空，二百米處望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Blundered shortly after the start, sat behind midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 起步後不久失蹄，居中間之後位置。末段難以望空，衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, keen early, under pressure to challenge leader 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬，早段搶口。五百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Sat on pace, raced wide, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W4W) Sat at the rear 3 wide, closed off okay from the rear. (Barrier manners unacceptable, must BT)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段自後列衝刺尚可。（閘廂行為難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Recovered from slow start to race in mid-field, race keenly throughout, driven 400m out, no extra final 200m.
(Blood in trachea and roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘緩慢，恢復走勢後居中間位置。沿途搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米再無餘力。
（氣管有血及再次患有喘鳴症。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （氣管有血及再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Stood flat-footed at start and lost ground, caught up to main body of runners after 700m, widest into home straight, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 開閘時四蹄滯立，因而失地。過了七百米處後追上主馬群。入直路時走最外疊。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, ridden along 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace, gave ground gradually inside 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列。最後三百米逐漸墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, similar position on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved grounds in the turn, limited response when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。受催策時反應一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat just off pace, one pace to the line. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居領放馬稍後位置。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From wide draw switched off to race in last 8-9Ls back, proved difficult to ride out when hung in in the home straight, failed to quicken and only ran past a couple of beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後八至九個馬位。直路上內閃之際難以被力策。末段未能加速，僅能超越兩匹已洩氣的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Settled behind midfield, switched out making the Turn, made good progress from the back, battled to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。其後自後列追前甚多，力拼至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, effort 400m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居後列，留力候上。四百米處發力。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 250m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 450M, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過四百五十米處後向外移出。入直路時落後三個半馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W4W5W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, still well back on turn, failed to make any progress in straight, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W4W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Sat last, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, raced in touch with leaders, ridden on bend to chase leaders, unable to secure clear run in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) Pressed leader, under pressure 400m out, hung out final 300m, stayed on but lost third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)追迫領放馬。四百米處受催策。最後三百米外閃。保持走勢，但失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, positioned a length behind the leader, nearer to the middle track, hard ridden after passing 300M, took the lead 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，落後領放馬一個馬位，靠近跑道中央競跑。跑過三百米處後受力策。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Drawn low and raced on outside towards center of track, tracked leaders, hung left under pressure, one paced final 100m, ran out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自內檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，靠近跑道中央競跑。其後在催策下外閃。最後一百米保持同速。末段空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped on jumping, raced in midfield on the stands' rail, 2 to 3 lengths back at 400M, kept on evenly to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走外欄。四百米處落後兩至三個馬位。末段保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders, pushed along 500m out to maintain position, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策以保持位置。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier but soon taken over 2L back travelling 3-wide without cover, similar into straight, fading when checked 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。二百米處勒避之際力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Never far off the pace, in the 6th spot at 400M less than 2L adrift of leader, failed to muster the speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;沿途距離領放馬不遠。四百米處居第六位，落後領放馬不足兩個馬位。未能加速展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, short of room 250m out to 150m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。二百五十米處至一百五十米處之間空位不足。其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Hurried along early stages from gate 12 and positioned one off the outside rail just behind the leading division, boxed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自第十二檔出閘，早段受催策，居領先馬匹稍後位置，走外欄第二疊。以佳勢力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Shifted out at start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden approaching 300M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)起步時向外斜跑。落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped on jumping, raced in midfield, nearer to the middle track, commenced move after passing 350M, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。跑過三百五十米處後開始上前。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Shalaa from Exploding Star, a daughter of Zoustar. Horses by the same sire include Georgian Sigma and Gor Gor. He was given five trials in Hong Kong for three placings. He shared the lead and finished third under pressure, beaten by 1-1/2Ls, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on August 30. In the latest trial, he sat not far from the pace and finished third under pressure, beaten by 5Ls, over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on September 15. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「勢力硬」(Shalaa)之後，在港同父馬包括「佐治傳奇」及「暴風一族」等駒，生母出自「摘星勇驥」(Zoustar)。抵港後五次試閘三次上名。8月30日出試田草1000米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.5個馬位。最近9月15日出試田泥1050米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬五個馬位。潛質不俗，初出預計會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in touch with leaders, tight for room and hampered 350m out, unable to secure clear run until 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;緊隨領先馬匹。三百五十米處受緊迫及受阻礙。其後未能望空直至一百米處。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, raced in midfield on the stands' side, made no progress final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, pushed along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。四百米處受推策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden hard to lead, weakened notably inside 300M, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在力策下取得領先。最後三百米顯著轉弱。對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Ridden along from a poor draw to be up with the pace 5-wide, closer to rail 3-wide rounding home bend and shared 2nd into straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策，跟隨領放馬，走第五疊。轉直路彎時移近內欄，走第三疊。入直路時並居第二位。最後三百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased leader, tight for room against rail and had to switch 200m out, stayed on at the one pace after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。沿欄受緊迫，二百米處須轉換跑線，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Raced prominently, led briefly 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。二百米處一度領先。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leader, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced 5 wide in midfield early. Not much progress in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 早段於馬群中間五疊位置競跑。直路上進展不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat at the rear, weakened and gave ground quickly in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Unacceptable Performance, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列。直路上迅速轉弱及墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，接近終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 800M, peaked on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 100M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列，走第二疊。接近八百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎未能再加速。直路早段轉弱。最後一百米收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, lost position after passing 750M, positioned 4 wide, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。跑過七百五十米處後失位。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位，走第四疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Mid-division, drifted left under pressure from 300m out, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起在催策下向外斜跑。保持走勢，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened final 150M.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。最後一百五十米轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked leaders, driven along 450m out, hung out final 400m, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受催策。最後四百米外閃。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away well, took the early lead, headed 600M, 2nd on turn, peaked 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段領放。六百米處被超越。直路彎居第二位。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed speed to get across, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現前速以切入內疊。直路初受催策。三百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat handy, weakened final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列。最後四百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, struggled to hold position halfway, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。半程時難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in mid-field towards centre of course, effort 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders against rail, short of room against rail from 400m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，走外欄。自四百米處起在外欄空位不足。殊不夠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat box-seat, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W3W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, hung out rounding the Home Turn, eased down soon after. (Racing Manners Unacceptable, must trial) (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。轉直路彎時外閃，其後瞬即收慢。（走勢難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Average to begin, raced in 3rd, 1 to 2 lengths back, 2nd on turn, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘一般，居第三位，落後一至兩個馬位。直路彎居第二位。直路早段略為追前，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run to turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off strongly, won by 2 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。入直路後保持走內疊。衝刺強勁，以兩個馬位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Crowded on jumping, raced in 2nd, a length or so back, peaked 300M, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時受擠迫，居第二位，落後約一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide, 4 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎落後相同距離。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Began awkwardly and lost ground, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, hard ridden after passing 300M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘笨拙及失地，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。跑過三百米處後受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, weakened passing 250M, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped out of stalls and lost balance, tracked leaders, ridden along 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時被碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped swiftly and cut across to the stands' rail, pressured for the lead throughout the event, run peaked at 200m and weakened gradually.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘迅速，切向外欄。沿途在催策下爭奪領先。二百米處未能再增速，逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped well, raced prominently on the stands' side, 3/4L back at 400M, took the lead approaching final 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居前列，靠近外欄競跑。四百米處落後四分三個馬位。趨近一百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 在催策下帶頭。保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed near 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。接近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in rear of mid-field, short of room final 400m, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間之後位置。最後四百米空位不足。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field towards outer, headway alongside winner 300m out, run petered out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，離外欄競跑。三百米處與頭馬一同追前。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced keenly throughout and had to make a wide forward move from the 700M, ran out abruptly near the 150M, faded and eased down thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 沿途搶口。自七百米處起須自外疊發力上前。接近一百五十米處時急促向外斜跑，力竭，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened and eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及觸碰對手，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 留居後列，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。末段以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Settled rear, raced keenly in the early stages, was held up for clear running until 300M, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 居後列，早段搶口。三百米處前受困而未能望空。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, race keenly throughout, angled off rail 400m out, short of room final 200m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。沿途搶口。四百米處移離內欄。最後二百米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after slowly away, pushed along towards centre of course 350m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。三百五十米處在跑道中央受推策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat rear, traveled on the rail, minor progress made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, keen mid-race, stayed on for pressure, no threat to winner, passed by runner-up final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。在催策下保持走勢。未能威脅頭馬。最後五十米被亞軍馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Mid-field, headway when badly hampered 250m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置。追前，二百五十米處受嚴重阻礙。未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Pressed leader, took narrow advantage 400m out, headed by winner 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;追迫領放馬。四百米處以短距離領先。三百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Commenced well, positioned a length behind the leader, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, weakened inside final furlong.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Held up towards centre of course, pushed along 550m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;留後，靠近跑道中央競跑。五百五十米處受推策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, ridden over 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。三百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Bumped and unbalanced at start, raced in midfield, 3 lengths or so back in the middle stages, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間位置，中段落後約三個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped shortly after start, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, 3 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden after passing 400M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生碰撞，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走外欄第四疊。跑過四百米處後受力策。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Shifted out shortly after start and bumped, raced prominently on the outside, peaked 500M, weakened gradually final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，被碰撞，居前列，走外疊。五百米處未能再增速。最後三百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Box seat, under pressure to hold position from 600m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。自六百米處起受催策以保持位置。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Up with early pace then eased to a trailing position behind leaders, fought on one paced early straight before overrun by rivals closing stages. (Jockey - instructed to go forward as it did in a barrier trial.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 早段跟上步速，其後收慢，居領先馬匹之後有遮擋的位置。直路早段保持同速，末段被對手超越。（騎師表示，他獲指示讓坐騎如試閘時般上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, didn't travel with much fluency early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，早段走勢欠順。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Clumsy start losing ground, soon recovered to forward of midfield on rail some 3L off the pace in 5th, angled out for a run entering straight but unable to quicken to threaten, hampered and faded 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間之前第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。進入直路時向外移出取位，但未能加速以構成威脅。受阻礙，五十米處力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) In midfield early stages before moving closer to track leaders entering home turn, driven final 200M and went to the line well. (Jockey - requested to take up a forward position from wide draw.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段居中間位置。入直路彎時追近，跟隨領先馬匹。最後二百米受催策。末段衝刺良佳。（騎師表示，他獲指示讓自外檔出閘的坐騎佔取前列位置。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon dropped to last few, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily in straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即墮居最後數位之內。入直路時走內疊節省腳程。直路上穩步上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked leaders, tended to hang right throughout, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。沿途傾向內閃。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, hung out on bend, left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎外閃。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent early stages, gradually drifted some 2L back to 4th onto course proper, came under pressure to hold place inside final the 300M, weakened steadily closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段居前列。跑離分支直路時逐漸墮居第四位，落後約兩個馬位。最後三百米受催策以保持位置。末段逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Ridden along to lead, unable to hold position from 400m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在催策下取得領先。自四百米處起未能保持位置。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch, under pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Dropped steadily to last few in back straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 對面直路上逐漸墮後，居最後數位之內，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, pushed along 300m out, stuck to task but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受推策。持續力拼，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, bumped 700m out and lost balance, taken wider on bend, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處被碰撞，失去平衡。直路彎被帶出較外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well, soon in front and led at steady pace, headed top of straight, fought hard but not going the pace of leaders final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，瞬即取得領先，以平穩步速領放。直路初被超越。力拼，但最後二百五十米加速不及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。
