runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled at the rear 3 wide, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Moderate start, gradually recovered along rail to be up with the pace after the first 200M, shifted 2L back to 4th 600M out on top of home bend, renewed effort inside final 200M but never threatened the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，其後沿欄逐漸恢復走勢，過了首二百米後跟上步速。六百米處直路彎早段居第四位，落後兩個馬位。最後二百米重新發力，但從未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, checked 200M, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處勒避。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Taken back to the rear from wide draw, remained in last 400M 5Ls to make up, came from well back and made some inroads, but couldn't get into it.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。四百米處仍居包尾位置，落後五個馬位。自遙遙落後的位置略為追前，但未能上前爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Waited with in rear, travelling smoothly but had to wait for a run in home straight, switched 150m out, ran on well to claim second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。走勢暢順，但在直路上須等待空位出現。一百五十米處轉換跑線。以佳勢上前，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear on the rail, switched out entering the Straight, made steady progress to the line.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內欄。入直路時向外移出。末段穩步上前。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W6W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide with cover, turned very wide into the home straight, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W6W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, did not finish off after being crowded near 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。接近三百米處時受擠迫，其後未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly and crowded, raced at tail, 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般及受擠迫，居包尾位置。入直路時落後七至八個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival turning in, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時與對手並排領先。直路初未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W) Chased leader, under pressure to challenge leaders 550m out, stayed on steadily, tight for room close home, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。五百五十米處在催策下挑戰領先馬匹。保持穩勢，接近終點時受緊迫，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Out with rest, sent forward to take the early lead, headed near 850M, 2nd on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，早段受催策上前領放。接近八百五十米處時被超越。直路彎居第二位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed 250m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速，二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, tended to shift right in home straight, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上傾向向內斜跑。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped and lost balance out of stalls, three wide in mid-field without cover, dropped away quickly 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞及失去平衡，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。三百米處迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Made running, headed over 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, same position on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, dropped towards rear on turn, emptied early in straight, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。直路彎墮居後列。直路早段力竭，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield, gave limited response turning home, couldn't sustain run mid-straight then faded to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時對催策反應平平。直路中段無以為繼。其後力竭，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, raced keenly, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along over 400m out, no headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策，未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Towards rear, struggling and left well behind from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列。自直路初起掙扎上前，落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W4W) Held up last, driven along and outpaced middle stages, wide into home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W4W) 留居包尾位置。中段受催策及被拋離。入直路時走外疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Shown good early speed to lead, kept on strongly, always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。末段保持勁勢，足以取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Began well, raced in 3rd, a length or so back, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run 100M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後約一個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, lacked pace to challenge, eased when detached 150m out.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。一百五十米處被拋離之際收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, finished off well, just missed out on 2nd in a photo.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。衝刺良佳，在電眼判決下僅失亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, ridden final bend to hold position, lost touch final 200m.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎在催策下保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Away well, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, similar position on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（異常呼吸狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, had to navigate traffic in the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路上須在馬群中穿插上前。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, made contact near 700M, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M, showed limited response thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。接近七百米處時發生觸碰。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空，一百五十米處望空，其後對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, pushed along 400m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。四百米處受推策，未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along 200m out, one paced and unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處受推策。保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 200m, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled well back from a wide barrier, did not find much room after straightening, one-paced inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後。入直路後空位不足。最後二百米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Mid-field, raced three wide, lost place top of home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初失位，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, raced keenly in the middle stages, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Mid-field, three wide, under pressure early in home straight, limited response, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路早段在催策下反應平平。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Soon recovered to forward of midfield from moderate start travelling 3-wide with cover, pulled closer to 2-wide in 5th within 3L of pace approaching first bend, quickened well inside final 300M only to find the winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間之前位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。趨近首個彎位時追近至第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位，走第二疊。最後三百米加速良佳，僅不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of midfield, slightly worse into home straight, inconvenienced over 250M out, kept on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時略為墮後。二百五十米處受妨礙，末段保持穩勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, made contact 700M, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。七百米處發生觸碰。入直路時落後三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) From draw 13 caught racing wide without cover in midfield, fought on under top weight in the home straight, just missed 3rd in a busy finish for the minor placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘後居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上在負頂磅下力拼。在多駒爭取入位下僅失季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Settled midfield on rail, navigated through traffic, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在馬匹之間穿插上前。末段走勢強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W5W) Jumped only fairly and made contact, raced 3 wide with cover towards rear, wider from 700M, moved closer on turn, finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰。居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。自七百米處起走更外疊。直路彎追近。衝刺強勁，取得亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Mid-field, chased winner home from 300m out, clear of rest but unable to close gap on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起追趕頭馬。拋離餘駒，但未能收窄與頭馬的距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速， 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎走更外疊。直路初對催策略有反應，一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Never far off, baulked briefly behind runners early in home straight, could only keep on steadily without quickening in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 從未遠離領先馬匹。直路初一度在馬群之後受困。末段僅能保持穩勢，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, soon headed by winner 150m out, stayed on well for a clear third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先，瞬即在一百五十米處被頭馬超越。保持佳勢，帶離餘駒，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen early, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon taken well behind from a poor draw trailing the field to straight, did not find much room on rail behind runners early in straight, running on when baulked again closing stages. (Tactic questioned)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後瞬即留居包尾位置。尾隨馬群至直路前。直路早段走內欄，但在馬群之後空位不足。末段上前時再度受困。（騎師被查詢競跑策略。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 600M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。跑過六百米處後略為追近。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Began well from a wide draw, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders in the 5th spot, kept on at same pace turning home, raced in restricted room 200M for some distance and failed to run on after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹，居第五位。轉直路彎時保持同速。二百米處在一段途程上在窄位競跑。其後未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Pressed forward under 10lb claimer, chased leader going into home turn, fought hard to stay in contention early straight, weakened final 100M. (Jockey reminded to ride out to the finish.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 在獲減十磅的騎師胯下受催策上前，入直路彎時追趕領放馬。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會，最後一百米轉弱。（騎師被提醒她有責任全力催策坐騎至終點。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat behind the leaders 2 wide, kept on nicely for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢暢順。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 400m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度極具爭勝機會。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leading pair, challenged 300m out and every chance, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。三百米處展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat handy on the rail, saved ground, showed some dash top of the Straight, one pace final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。走內欄節省腳程。直路初略為加速上前。最後一百米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden forward from widest draw and across to make running, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，切入以領放。一百米處被超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a steady pace, gained 1L advantage shortly after straightening, unable to sustain effort and outsprinted inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 瞬即以平穩步速領放。入直路後不久領先一個馬位。最後一百米無以為繼，被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From wide draw went forward to chase leader along the 2-path, didn't finish as well as his rivals from 300M, weakened 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，上前追趕領放馬，走第二疊。自三百米處起衝刺不及對手。一百五十米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from draw 1, set pace and led the field until 300M, battled on latter stages to finish a non- threatening 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，以偏快步速領放直至三百米處。末段力拼，取得第四名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, tight for room turning into home straight, clear run 300m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時受緊迫。三百米處望空。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken forward from wide draw and tracked leader, challenged and every chance to 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後上前，跟隨領放馬。其後展開挑戰，一百五十米處前已獲機會盡展所長，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped exiting stalls, raced in touch with leaders, unable to hold position by 600m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，緊隨領先馬匹。六百米處未能保持位置。洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W) After 100m raced very awkwardly, became unbalanced and hung left, lost considerable ground in the process and quickly tailed off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W) 跑了一百米後走勢非常笨拙，失去平衡及外閃，因而失地甚多，瞬即居包尾位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped on jumping, trapped very wide early, a length or so back, 2 wide from 900M, same margin back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 躍出時發生碰撞，早段落後約一個馬位，走大外疊。自九百米處起走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled handy, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place entering home straight, checked 300m out, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時仍居包尾位置。三百米處勒避。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Tracked leaders, taken wider 500m out, short-lived challenge top of home straight, faded final 200m.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處移出較外疊。直路初一度展開挑戰。最後二百米力竭。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Mid division, niggled along 600m out, dropped away quickly final 400m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置。六百米處受催策。最後四百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Sat midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。受催策時保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped after the start, from draw 1 stayed close to leaders along the inside, failed to run on passing 250M, weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔起步後被碰撞，保持緊隨領先馬匹，走內疊。跑過二百五十米處時未能追前。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W) Sat last, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled towards the rear, slightly drifted back rounding the home turn, made good late progress final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。轉直路彎時略為墮退。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Raced in touch, sticking to task but lacked speed to challenge when short of room 150m out to 50m out.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。持續力拼，但一百五十米處至五十米處之間空位不足，未能增速以展開挑戰。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W) Stayed close enough in the group chasing leaders, quickly beaten turning home and dropped away.
(Blood in trachea and continuous epiglottic entrapment.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Blood in trachea and continuous epiglottic entrapment.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W) 居於追趕領先馬匹的馬群中，保持落後不遠。轉入直路時迅速洩氣，墮退。
（氣管有血及會厭持續被覆蓋。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （氣管有血及會厭持續被覆蓋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat box seat, held up in the Straight, made good late ground once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路上受困，末段望空後追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace against rail, had to wait for run 400m out, quickened between rivals to lead 250m out, soon clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。四百米處須等待空位出現。二百五十米處在對手之間加速，取得領先。瞬即帶離對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W) In touch with leaders, hung left early on, under pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，早段外閃。三百米處受催策，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, ridden 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追逼領放馬。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Began well from the widest draw, tracked leaders on the outside, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, raced keenly throughout, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。沿途搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) One of quickest away from the stalls, raced keenly in the early stages, held up for a short distance early part of the straight, knuckled down to the task once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘最快馬匹之一。早段搶口。直路早段在一段短途程上受困。末段望空後瞬即力拼上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Bounded as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, good headway halfway out, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向上跳躍及失地，居後列。半程時追前甚多。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Settled in mid-field, keen middle stages, commenced move out wide 600m out, bumped and lost balance 500m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。六百米處開始上前，走外疊。五百米處發生碰撞及失去平衡。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Raced wide, improved to press leader 900m out, pressed on 300m out, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 走外疊。九百米處上前追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled wide, hampered when being taken wider inside 300M, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。三百米處在被帶出較外疊之際受阻礙。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and lost ground leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, hampered against rail 800m out, gave ground in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘後向外斜跑及失地，居中間位置，走內欄。八百米處沿欄受阻礙。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race at tail, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約五個馬位，直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled near the rear 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and slowly away, in rear, minor headway late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及緩慢，居後列。末段略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) From wide draw given a waiting ride towards the rear 3-wide, had 6Ls to make up 400M, closed off fastest and not far behind the minor placegetters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘，留力待上，居後列，走第三疊。四百米處落後六個馬位。末段衝刺最快，落後入位馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。入直路後持續走內疊，略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後留居後列。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on final 250m, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。最後二百五十米保持走勢，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Across from wide draw to race outside of leader, stayed prominent until 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入內疊，居領放馬外側。保持居前列直至二百米處。其後力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初一度發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, headway up rail final 200m, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米沿欄上前。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Away well, positioned 2 wide in midfield in the early stages, slightly dropped towards rear after passing 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, showed no response in straight, eased final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後略為墮居後列。轉入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上對催策毫無反應。最後一百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began awkwardly and bumped, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, dropped towards rear gradually after passing 700M, 6-1/2L back turning in, weakened and eased early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與一駒互相碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。跑過七百米處後逐漸墮居後列。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路初轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, no clear run approaching 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。趨近一百五十米處時未能望空。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon recovered to just worse than midfield on rail after moderate start, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通後瞬即恢復走勢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Blundered shortly after the start, sat towards rear, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久失蹄，居後列。從未能構成威脅。(見競賽事件報告。)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Shifted out abruptly at start, trapped wide in midfield, hung out after passing 700M, dropped to rear on turn, weakened early in straight, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時急促向外斜跑，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後外閃。直路彎墮居後列。直路初轉弱。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, difficult to settle in the early stages, found rail near 800M, 3-1/2L back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 躍出時被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。早段難以穩定走勢。接近八百米處時移入內欄。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, ridden along 400m out to chase leader, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領放馬。末段保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced wide without cover throughout, improved to press leader 700m out, pressed on 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 沿途在沒有遮擋下走外疊。七百米處推進以追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, pushed along to chase leader top of home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。直路初受推策，追趕領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W3W) Tracked leaders, pushed along 450m out to chase leaders, unable to match winner but stayed on steadily, lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。未能追上頭馬，但保持穩勢。末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away in line, stayed close enough to leaders, moved up to 2nd top of straight, responded well to take lead near 200M but couldn't hold off winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，保持落後領先馬匹不遠。直路初上前進佔第二位。對催策反應良佳，接近二百米處時取得領先，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From wide draw crossed to race in a 2-wide spot just off leaders, responded well leaving the bend to be challenging for the lead mid-straight, hard driven final 200M and only went down by a neck . Game in defeat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，切入第二疊，緊隨領先馬匹。離開直路彎時對催策反應良佳。直路中段爭奪領先。最後二百米受力策，在力拼下僅以一馬頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled ahead of midfield, disadvantaged by racing wide without cover throughout, responded fairly when asked in the straight and couldn't get closer to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置。沿途在沒有遮擋下走外疊，不利發揮。直路上對催策反應一般。未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, some headway against rail in home straight, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路上沿欄略為追前。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, keen 1100m out, short of room early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。千一米處搶口。直路早段空位不足。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路初一度發力。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Guided to a rail spot in second half of the field, saved ground throughout the event, quickened up nicely passing 350M, led near 50M winning determinedly.
(Sustained a wound to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a wound to the right knee.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 留居後半馬群中，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。跑過三百五十米處時加速良佳。接近五十米處時取得領先，在力拼下掄元。
（右膝有傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Badly crowded and bumped at start, settled in rear of mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫，被碰撞。居中間之後位置。未能望空直至二百米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Chased leaders on the inside, fought on well enough passing 350M but was always held by first two final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 追趕領先馬匹，走內疊。跑過三百五十米處時以頗佳走勢力拼，但最後二百米一直落後頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W4W) Waited with in rear, keen middle stages, pushed along widest into home straight, hung in but ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。中段搶口。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。內閃，但最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, disputed led middle stages, led again 600m out, headed 250m out, weakened quickly final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。中段爭奪領先，六百米處再度領先。二百五十米處被超越，最後一百五十米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Gradually settled in midfield 3-wide with cover, commenced move 400M out swinging one of the widest into straight, ran on under pressure but swamped for a placing inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 逐漸居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。四百米處開始上前。入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。在催策下上前，但最後五十米被超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced in 3rd, 2 lengths or so back, same position on turn, kept on well until approaching final 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。直路彎居相同位置。保持佳勢直至趨近一百米處，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Moved up to race outside the lead and pressed leader during the event, weakened final 200M and was eased when no chance. (Jockey - raced too keenly and couldn't finish off in the straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 上前居領放馬外側。陣上追迫領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。在爭勝無望時收慢。（騎師表示，坐騎過於搶口，因而在直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, showed good speed to lead, challenged by rivals top of home straight, gave ground final 150m.
(Lost right hind plate.)
(Sustained a minor abrasion to its right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a minor abrasion to its right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，展現甚快前速領放。直路初被對手挑戰。最後一百五十米墮退。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）
（右後腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Made all, showed speed to get across, kicked top of home straight, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 帶頭，展現前速以切入。直路初加速。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Showed speed to get across, headed by winner 200m out, weakened final 100m, tight for room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。二百米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米轉弱。最後五十米受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至二百米處。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Crowded and bumped leaving stalls, raced in rear, still in rear top of home straight, briefly hampered 200m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居後列。直路初仍居後列。二百米處一度受阻礙，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, mid division, had to wait for run top of home straight, driven 300m out, ran on well final 200m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。直路初須等待空位出現。三百米處受催策。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged leaders 600m out, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處挑戰領先馬匹。直路初加速，取得領先。一百米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Bumped after the start, restrained at the rear and caught wide no cover throughout, made only limited progress in the straight and was never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步後發生碰撞，受約束。沿途居後列，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上僅能略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in midfield, baulked for a run in home straight until over 250M out, ran on well under pressure to hit the front 150M out and soon drew clear.
(Jockey dropped right rein for a number of strides at 200M.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped right rein for a number of strides at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路上受困直至二百五十米處。在催策下走勢良佳，一百五十米處取得領先，瞬即帶離對手勝出。
（於二百米騎師在數步之間右邊韁繩脫手。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百米騎師在數步之間右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Mainly in midfield, tight between runners early in straight and checked 280M out, steadied again 180M out, made no further impression in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 大多居中間位置。直路初在馬匹之間緊迫競跑，二百八十米處勒避。一百八十米處再度收慢。末段再無表現。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Wootton Bassett from Sei Stella, a daughter of Not A Single Doubt. Horses by the same sire include Viva Chaleur and Stunning Peach. This fellow had seven starts in Australia for one win (a 2yo maiden over 1000m) and two placings. He was given two trials in Hong Kong for two wins. He shared the lead and won under pressure, by 5-3/4L, over 1050m AWT in Conghua on July 2. In the latest trial, he made all to win under slight pressure, by 3/4L, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 4. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「活頓鎮」(Wootton Bassett)之後，在港同父馬包括「爆熱」及「桃花開」等駒，生母出自「勇無疑」(Not A Single Doubt)。來港前在澳洲七戰得一勝兩位，勝出一場為1000米兩歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後兩次試閘全勝。7月2日出試從化泥地1050米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下以5.75個馬位之先勝出。最近9月4日出試從化草地1200米，早段領放，末段稍騎下以0.75個馬位之先勝出。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier to soon take up running on the rail, led until joined 600M out, unable to sustain effort and swamped 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前，瞬即取得領先，走內欄。領放，直至六百米處被追上。其後未能保持走勢，一百五十米處被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, driven along 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Led early, ceded advantage for one-back 2nd after the first 200M, re-gained lead in home straight 300M out kicking over 2L clear over 150M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段領先，過了首二百米後被超越，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路上三百米處重奪領先位置。一百五十米處加速帶離逾兩個馬位。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a fast pace in middle stages, led the field until headed 250M out and swamped for a placing inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段以快步速領放。帶頭競跑，直至二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米被後上馬匹過頭，失去三甲位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside lead, traveled strongly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走勢強勁。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑，在領放下受追迫。二百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased the leader, reluctant to improve, gave ground from 250M (See Incident Report, Disappointing Performance, Must BT).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。不願推進。自二百五十米處起墮退。（見競賽事件報告。表現令人失望，必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Chased leader in joint 2nd or 3rd on rail, came under pressure to hold place rounding home bend, dropped out of contention shortly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 追趕領放馬，並列第二或第三位，走內欄。轉直路彎時在催策下保持位置。入直路後不久墮退，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled in the back half of the field 6Ls off leader, couldn't go on passing 300M, dropped out rapidly well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬六個馬位。跑過三百米處時未能上前。迅速墮退，所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, found rail near 900M, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened 300M, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初對催策毫無反應。三百米處轉弱。包尾大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, ran on strongly, won going away, impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。走勢強勁，帶離勝出。表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted in shortly after start and made contact, sent forward to take the lead, hard ridden from 300M, peaked and headed 150M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久向內斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，受催策上前領放。自三百米處起受力策。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Prominent, improved to lead against far rail 600m out, driven 400m out, headed by winner 200m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)居前列。沿外欄推進上前，六百米處取得領先。四百米處受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越，未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made running against stand rail, kicked 1.5L clear 300m out, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;沿外欄帶頭。三百米處加速帶離一個半馬位。一百米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, peaked approaching 300M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。趨近三百米處時未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Jumped with them, raced prominently, 2 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden from 300M but failed to quicken, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，走外欄第三疊。自三百米處起受力策，但未能加速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路早段加速，二百米處領先。一百米處被頭馬超越，其後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Raced prominently, moved up to outside of leader before halfway, led 200m out, asserted and won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居前列。半程前推進至領放馬外側。二百米處取得領先。控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly better than midfield, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。末段以勁勢衝刺，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W5W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced near the rear always, failed to pick up in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，沿途居後列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Disputed led early stages, pressed leader middle stages, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 早段爭奪領先。中段追迫領放馬。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先。二百米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crossed from wide draw to make running, headed over 200m out, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。最後一百米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled in midfield along the inside, ran home only fairly from 300M. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內疊。自三百米處起衝刺僅屬一般。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from a poor draw, gradually settled just off the pace 3-wide without cover, bumped and lost further ground 600M out, weakened from 3.5L 5th into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，逐漸居領放馬稍後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處發生碰撞及進一步失地。入直路時居五位，落後三個半馬位，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled ahead of midfield never far off from the pace, brought wide for his run 400M, was steadied 250M but never going the pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，從未遠離領放馬。四百米處向外移出取位。二百五十米處收慢，但從未能加速上前挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Prominent, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, ran on well but headed on line by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路早段加速，二百五十米處進佔領先位置。保持佳勢，但終點線上被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide throughout, responded fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(4W4W) 居中間之前位置。沿途走外疊。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide, under pressure to hold position 600m out, never a threat but not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。六百米處在催策下保持位置。從未能構成威脅，但所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) In touch with leaders, ridden into home straight, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時受催策。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, hung out in the turn, not much impression made. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎外閃。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Started well and across from wide draw to track leading pair, moved smoothly to front 200m out, winner too strong final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入跟隨領先兩駒。走勢暢順，二百米處取得領先。最後五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (4W2W2W) Jumped well from gate 10, raced prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(4W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。轉入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢，一百五十米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, stayed on for clear second but never quite able to challenge winner.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。保持走勢，跑獲亞軍，帶離餘駒，但從未能真正挑戰頭馬。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Ridden forward from wide stall, tracked leading pair, loomed up to lead 200m out, ran on well to line but headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處上前領放。保持佳勢至終點，但接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled nicely, led all the way to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 在力策下取得領先。走勢良佳。其後直領到底，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked pace, keen when hampered after 400m, lacked speed to challenge winner final 300m but stayed on for clear second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。跑了四百米後受阻礙時搶口。最後三百米未能增速以挑戰頭馬，但保持走勢，帶離餘駒，獲得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W2W) Settled at the back and waited with, commenced move entering home straight obtaining a clear run over 200M out, responded well under pressure but the post came too soon.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W2W) 居包尾位置，留力候上。入直路時開始上前。二百米處望空。末段對催策反應良佳，但為時已晚。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderate start, settled at the back, produced good late impression in home straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居後列。直路上追前頗多。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, headway halfway out, wide into home straight, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。半程時上前。入直路時走外疊。末段在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Not hurried early and middle stages, raced at the rear 6Ls off the fast pace, made some progress final 400M and just missed out on 3rd place. Soundly beaten by the winner KA YING RISING.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 早段及中段未受催策，居後列，落後步速甚快的領放馬六個馬位。最後四百米略為追前，僅失季軍。在頭馬「嘉應高昇」之後所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) In midfield, raced keenly early and middle stages, drifted back to the rear after being checked 800M, ran home fairly final 400M. No impression on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。早段及中段搶口。八百米處勒避。其後墮居後列。最後四百米走勢一般。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W7W) Travelled 3-wide in last few, shifted widest for a run into straight, ran on quite well but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W7W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊。入直路時移出最外疊取位。走勢頗佳，但最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Began awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered to rear of the field, gained slightly closer to 9th 1000M out before unbalanced and lost position 750M out, ran on dourly on straightening to hit the front about 70M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居馬群後列。一千米處略為追近，居第九位。七百五十米處失去平衡及失位。入直路時持續力拼，約七十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Out in line, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 4-1/2L back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，留居後列，走外疊。轉入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in rear over 7L off the pace, baulked until inside the 200M out, quickened well to reach distant 2nd 60M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，落後領放馬逾七個馬位。受困直至二百米處。末段加速良佳，六十米處進佔落後頗遠的第二位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped well and reserved in midfield, battled on well to take 2nd near 150M but once again proved no match for champion KA YING RISING.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，留居中間位置。以佳勢力拼，接近一百五十米處時進佔第二位，但再次不敵香港馬王「嘉應高昇」。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, closed off nicely, just no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W6W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide approaching 600M, carried wider turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W6W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近六百米處時走第三疊。入直路時被帶出更外疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, no clear run in the early straight, made good ground in the final furlong, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空。最後二百米追前甚多，末段以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Jumped well from draw 2, reserved in midfield 2-wide, brought wide 450M to challenge, couldn't quicken enough under top weight, went to the line moderately.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 自第二檔出閘迅速，留居中間位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處移出外疊展開挑戰。負頂磅下加速力不足，保持普通走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled towards rear in 11th and waited with, baulked for a run after straightening until inside the 300M, finished off the race well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居後列第十一位，留力候上。入直路後受困直至三百米處。在催策下於末段以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield, commenced move upon straightening and responded well to take charge over 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時開始上前。對催策反應良佳，一百五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, challenged up rail from 250m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。自二百五十米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Given a waiting ride at the rear of the field, brought wide 550M, ran on without serious threat. (Jockey reminded to ride out to the finish of the race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 居後列，留力候上。五百五十米處被帶出外疊。未能構成真正威脅。（小組提醒騎師有責任確保全力催策坐騎至終點。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 600M, very wide turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, quickened between horses to lead 150m out and soon on top, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在馬群之中加速上前，一百五十米處取得領先，瞬即帶離對手。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, commenced move approaching 500M, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 75M, soon in command, won very comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。趨近五百米處時開始上前。直路上對催策反應甚佳。七十五米處取得領先。瞬即控制大局。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon recovered along the rail from a slow start, over 2L back in 5th before gaining slightly closer to pace into home straight, tightened when beaten inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，瞬即恢復走勢，居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時略為追近領放馬。二百米處在受緊迫之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sluggish start, raced in touch with leaders, taken wider 700m out, bumped 250m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，緊隨領先馬匹。七百米處移出較外疊。二百五十米處被碰撞，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 700M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走第二疊。七百米處移入內欄。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) In midfield early before moving closer to leaders from 1000M, caught racing wide no cover to the straight, run ended 300M and dropped out from contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 早段居中間位置。自一千米處起追近領先馬匹。直路前走外疊，沒有遮擋。三百米處無以為繼。其後墮退，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, made good ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢良佳。在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W4W) Jumped fairly from draw 11, taken back to last 7-8Ls off the pace middle stages, wide into straight before closing off nicely to take 3rd. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W4W) 自第十一檔出閘僅屬一般，中段留居包尾位置，落後領放馬七至八個馬位。入直路時走外疊，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W4W) Taken well behind from a poor draw, travelled keenly in last on rail before pulling his way forward to 11th onto home bend, shifted wide for home straight but did not find much room early on, kept on same pace in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W4W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，走內欄，搶口。開始轉直路彎時進佔第十一位。入直路時移出外疊，但早段空位不足。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Chased the leader, traveled nicely, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 追趕領放馬，走勢良佳。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden early to share the pace, obtained outright lead on rail 1000M out and led until headed inside the 400M, soon faded in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，並排領先。一千米處沿欄單騎領放。四百米處被超越。直路上瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Vied for lead early crossing to rail in front just inside the 1100M, kicked 2L clear briefly rounding home bend before joined into straight and eventually headed inside the 200M. (Riding in home straight questioned.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑過千一米處後切入內欄領放。轉直路彎時加速，一度帶離兩個馬位。入直路時被追上，二百米處被超越。（騎師被查詢在直路上的騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a poor draw, set a fast tempo after obtaining rails run 1200M out, led the field until overhauled inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘瞬即取得領先。千二米處移入內欄後以快步速領放。保持領先直至最後二百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Quickly into stride, led and set fast pace to the straight, headed passing 400M, held 2nd to about 150M, no extra close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 展步迅速，取得領先。直路前以甚快步速領放。跑過四百米處時被超越。保持居第二位直至約一百五十米處。接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Began fairly, soon recovered along the rail to just over 2L back in 4th, drifted from 1L off to over 2L back when pace quickened around the bend, gave ground steadily under pressure from approaching home turn.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，瞬即恢復走勢，居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時賽事步速加快，由落後一個馬位墮退至落後逾兩個馬位。自趨近直路彎起在催策下逐漸墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Broke well from a wide draw to soon lead or dispute lead, hit the front briefly just inside the 300M and soon weakened out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，瞬即領放或爭奪領先。跑過三百米處後一度取得領先，瞬即轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in rear of midfield, came to challenge inside the 400M and ran on well under pressure to assert authority 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。四百米處上前展開挑戰。其後在催策下以佳勢追前，一百米處控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Settled in midfield in 7th some 4L off the pace, saved ground turning in for home but baulked for a run in straight until inside the 250M and again when forced to switch out just inside the 100M, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 居中間第七位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。直路上受困直至二百五十米處。跑過一百米處後被迫向外移出之際再次受困。末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W5W) Held up wide in last few racing keenly early stages, commenced move in wider into home straight, only produced moderate impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 早段留居最後數位之內，走外疊，搶口。入直路時開始上前，走更外疊。表現僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Awkward start and lost ground, rail position in rear of mid-field, briefly tight for room early in home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路早段一度受緊迫。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Reserved behind midfield 4-5Ls off the pace, held up for clear running from 400M-200M before coming through strongly to win by 2L at the end. Extraordinarily performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 留居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空。其後以勁勢穿插上前，過終點時以兩個馬位之先勝出。表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled down nicely in midfield, switched away from fence 700M, quickened up well early straight to lead inside 300M, kept going strongly for an impressive win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走勢良佳。七百米處移離內欄。直路早段以佳勢加速，三百米處取得領先，保持勁勢，勝出賽事，表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, bumped near 1100M, 1/2L back on turn, hit the front 300M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位。接近千一米處時發生碰撞。直路彎落後半個馬位。三百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W) Slow to begin, recovered to race behind midfield, came under pressure home turn, couldn't go on passing 250M and soon left behind by leaders.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間之後位置。直路彎受催策。跑過二百五十米處時未能追前，瞬即被領先馬匹拋離。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled well behind and waited with, obtained a clear run upon straightening 400M out, finished off the race strongly down the centre of track.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 遙居於後，留力候上。四百米處入直路時望空。在跑道中央以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W5W) 自最外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後六至七個馬位，走大外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Raced in touch with leaders out wide, tended to hang out on bend, pushed ahead over 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。直路彎傾向外閃。二百米處受推策上前。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, did not travel with much fluency on bend, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, ran on strongly final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎走勢欠順。未能望空直至三百米處。最後二百米以勁勢上前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, steadied near 900M, 3 wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時收慢。入直路時走第三疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Away well enough, up with early pace before easing back to sit behind leaders, challenged strongly for the lead from 250M, led nearing 50M but was caught by winner last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘頗佳，早段跟上步速，其後收慢留居領先馬匹之後。自二百五十米處起以勁勢上前挑戰，爭奪領先。接近五十米處時取得領先，但最後一步被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier to share the pace 2-wide, drifted slightly backward rounding home bend before hitting the front just inside the 400M, kicked over 1L clear 200M out only to be swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，並排領先，走第二疊。轉直路彎時略為墮退。跑過四百米處後取得領先。二百米處加速帶離逾一個馬位，僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, short of room against rail top of home straight, checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。直路初走內欄，空位不足。二百米處勒避。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, taken widest into home straight, ran on well to challenge 200m out, tired closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走最外疊。二百米處以佳勢追前以展開挑戰。末段呈疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled about 6L off the pace in 4th on rail, in similar position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening the place-getters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第四位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走內欄。入直路時居相若位置。末段持續力拼，但未能威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W4W) Settled in midfield, came under pressure over 500M out, made no impression in straight but dropped away quickly inside final 150M.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。五百米處受催策。直路上毫無表現，最後一百五十米迅速墮退。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Pressed forward from wide draw without cover 1200M out to join the leader onto home bend, some 1L back 2-wide into the straight, weakened under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前。千二米處沒有遮擋。開始轉直路彎時追上領放馬。入直路時落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。最後三百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon led setting steady pace in front under 10lb claimer, headed 350M but refused to give in, fought bravely to the line for a respectable 4th .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 由獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎，瞬即取得領先，以平穩步速領放。三百五十米處被超越，但奮力頑抗，力拼至終點，取得第四名，表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Soon led under 10lb claimer, set slow pace early stages before quickening up halfway, was strongly pressed by eventual 2nd final 250M but held on bravely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 由獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎，瞬即領放。早段以慢步速領放。半程時加速。最後二百五十米受亞軍馬匹以勁勢追迫，但力保勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) In front early stages but was restrained to race behind leader on settling, couldn't find extra gear to challenge passing 350M, faded final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段居前列，其後受約束以跟隨領放馬。跑過三百五十米處時未能加速以展開挑戰，末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front from 500m out, stayed on well in home straight but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。自五百米處起在領放下受追迫。直路上保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Led early stages, narrowly headed 2-wide 800M out, faded further out of contention inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段領放。八百米處被超越，落後短距離，走第二疊。最後三百米力竭，進一步墮退，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled comfortably, closed off strongly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢暢順。末段衝刺強勁。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W3W) Slowly away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off strongly, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空。三百米處望空，末段衝刺強勁，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Crowded on jumping, raced 2 wide at rear, there to turn, closed off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 躍出時受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Away well, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 600M, hard ridden after passing 400M, took the lead 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。自六百米處起走第二疊。跑過四百米處後受力策。二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders, quickened up well passing 350M, led nearing 150M, held on well for the lead final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 保持緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百五十米處時加速良佳。接近一百五十米處時取得領先。末段以佳勢力拼，保住領先位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, driven 500m out, shifted right final 200m, stayed on but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。最後二百米向內斜跑。保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, good headway on bend, ran on well to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多。以佳勢上前，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Settled midfield 3 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly, held off a late challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺強勁，末段力拒對手的挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from gate 11, raced prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, challenged the leader early in straight, peaked on run near 200M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段挑戰領放馬。接近二百米處時未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W3W) Chased leader, remained prominent 900m out, switched and under pressure 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 追趕領放馬。九百米處保持居前列。五百米處轉換跑線，受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, took the lead after passing 850M, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。跑過八百五十米處後取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Led steadily, kept finding when challenged by rivals in the straight, couldn't hold off winner passing 150M but continued bravely to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 以平穩步速領放。直路上受對手挑戰時持續力拼。跑過一百五十米處時未能抗衡頭馬，但繼續奮勇力拼，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Prominent, ridden to chase leader 500m out, struggled to hold position in home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居前列。五百米處受催策追趕領放馬。直路上難以保持位置。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Stepped away cleanly from barrier 9, raced prominently to be 3/4L outside the leader, stuck to the task and dug deep to fend off a late challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自第九檔出閘俐落，居前列，落後四分三個馬位，在領放馬外側競跑。持續力拼，末段力拒對手的挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, travelled smoothly to chase leaders top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初走勢暢順，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Reserved behind midfield early stages, shuffled back to the rear entering home turn, failed to run on final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段留居中間之後位置。進入直路彎時墮居後列。最後四百米未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped at start, unable to shift near the rail until taken back to rear 2-wide approaching the winning post the first time, remained towards rear to straight, tightened badly inside the 150M, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，未能移近內欄。首次趨近終點時留居後列，走第二疊。直路前仍居後列。最後一百五十米嚴重受緊迫。末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Towards rear most of the way, ran on past well-beaten horses inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 大部分途程居後列。最後二百米上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, shuffled back mid-race, pushed along widest into home straight, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W1W2W) 居後列，留力待上。中段墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, keen early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力待上。早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, followed runner-up through 300m out, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W4W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。未能增速以展開挑戰。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W5W) Crowded shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W5W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路初略為追前。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W2W) Clean jump, raced in 2nd, a length back, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 100M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W2W) 出閘俐落，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Lowered its head as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, severely checked 1400m out, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 開閘時將頭低俯，失地，居後列。千四米處大力勒避。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W3W) Reserved behind midfield, pace very slow first half of the race, switched away from fence 400M, ran on steadily to the line without threatening first three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W3W) 留居中間之後位置，賽事前半段步速非常緩慢。自四百米處起移離內欄。末段以穩勢上前，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield, gained 6th into back straight about 4L back, swung one of the widest into straight, responded well inside final 200M to hit the front 100M out and soon kicked clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。入對面直路時進佔第六位，落後約四個馬位。入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。最後二百米對催策反應良佳。一百米處取得領先，瞬即帶離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W5W) Held up near last in a strongly run race, pushed along 550M, brought wide for his challenge but failed to come on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 留居接近包尾位置，賽事步速甚快。五百五十米處受推策。移出外疊展開挑戰，但未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, chased along final bend, tight of room 400m out to 200m out and lost balance 250m out, weaved through field to lead final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎追趕對手。四百米處至二百米處之間受緊迫。二百五十米處失去平衡。穿過馬群上前，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
（異常呼吸狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, ridden top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear, placed under pressure 550M but failed to respond to riding. (Trainer : disadvantaged by settling back / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。五百五十米處受催策，對催策毫無反應。（練馬師表示，此駒居後列不利發揮。／賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, raced in rear, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, ran on well final 200m to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。未能望空直至三百米處。最後二百米以佳勢追前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Mid-field, had to wait for clear run 400m out, one paced once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處須等待空位。望空後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, made contact early in straight, weakened gradually final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初發生觸碰。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Pressed forward, emerged as leader 850M setting good pace to straight, headed by winner near 250M, faded late to finish 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 受催策上前，八百五十米處取得領先。直路前以中等步速領放。接近二百五十米處時被頭馬超越，末段力竭，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W) Up with leaders early stages before settling down in a trailing position just off the pace, kept on one paced under top weight on straightening, always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W) 早段跟上領先馬匹，其後居領放馬稍後有遮擋的位置。入直路時在負頂磅下保持同速，一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Jumped well from gate 12, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded at start, made running, race keenly throughout, headed by winner 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，帶頭競跑。沿途搶口。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。
