runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw to travel 3-wide without cover towards rear in 8th, widest turning in for home, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列第八位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉入直路時走最外疊。末段在跑道中央受催策上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on rail, 2 wide turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually close home.
(Sustained a laceration to the left front cannon.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a laceration to the left front cannon.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內欄。入直路時走第二疊。直路初追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。
（左前腿管骨部位割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W6W) Sluggish start, dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but no further impression close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W6W) 自大外檔起步緩慢，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但接近終點時再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Gradually settled towards rear racing 3-wide with cover down back straight, swung one of the widest turning in for home, ran on dourly under pressure to claim victory close to post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 對面直路上逐漸居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。在催策下持續力拼，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Settled down in midfield along the 2-path, driven wide into straight, couldn't sustain run passing 250M and weakened. (Jockey - horse lay out in the home straight. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時受催策，走外疊。跑過二百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在直路上外閃。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Soon taken across from a poor draw for rails run in midfield in 7th some 4L off the pace, gained slightly closer to 6th in back straight, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即切入內欄取位，居中間第七位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。對面直路上略為追近至第六位。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。以穩勢上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 200m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。二百米處向外移出取位。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Made running, headed by winner 350m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 領放。三百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Soon took up running from a wide barrier setting a steady pace on rail, drew over 3L clear upon straightening, eased closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即帶頭，以平穩步速領放，走內欄。入直路時帶離逾三個馬位。末段在收慢下勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Moderately away from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) From draw 14 went forward, in 3rd spot going into home turn, briefly in front 350M but couldn't hold off the first 3 finishers mid-straight, no extra late under top weight and lost 4th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後上前。進入直路彎時居第三位。三百五十米處一度領先，但直路中段未能抗衡三甲馬匹。在負頂磅下末段再無餘力，接近終點時失去第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) In the group chasing leaders early stages, raced keenly and allowed to move closer to the pace passing 1000M, ran on same pace in the straight, lost 2nd inside 100M, weakened to 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 早段追趕領先馬匹，搶口，跑過一千米處時獲許上前追近領放馬。直路上保持同速。一百米處失去第二位，其後轉弱，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W5W) Raced in rear after crowded and bumped out of stalls, headway halfway into mid-field, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W5W) 出閘時受擠迫及發生碰撞，其後居後列。半程時追前至中間位置。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Raced keenly when being restrained for cover behind leader, in 3rd place turning home, held up for clear running 400M-50M before closing off well late to take 5th. Could have done better.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 在受約束以取得領放馬之後有遮擋的位置之際搶口。轉直路彎時居第三位。四百米處至五十米處之間受困而未能望空，末段以佳勢衝刺，跑獲第五名。本應可取得更好成績。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W3W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 1000M, a length or so back on turn, 3 wide turning in, showed limited response in straight, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居前列，走第二疊。接近一千米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎落後約一個馬位。入直路時走第三疊。直路上對催策反應平平。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, cleared 300M, finished off well to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處望空，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, hard ridden after passing 300M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。跑過三百米處後受力策。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。以勁勢上前，一百五十米處取得領先。末段領先距離收窄，但仍保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W) Sat rear, commenced to improve from near the 800M, held up at the early Straight, closed off strongly (See incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W) 居後列。自接近八百米處起開始推進。直路初受困。衝刺強勁。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W) Disputed led early stages, led outright 800m out, challenged by winner top of home straight, headed 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W) 早段爭奪領先。八百米處單騎領放。直路初被頭馬挑戰。二百米處被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 1 obtained a midfield position along the inside, cut the corner home turn and quickly moved up to 3rd top of the straight, held for 400M to 300M before running on moderately. Just missed 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初迅速進佔第三位。四百米處至三百米處之間受困，其後走勢普通，僅失季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步時被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空，二百米處望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure to hold position 700m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。七百米處受催策以保持位置。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken across to the fence after the start, severely checked 1100M and fell back to detached last, out of contention and wasn't ridden out for the remainder of the race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後切入內欄。千一米處大力勒避，墮居遙遙落後的包尾位置。再無爭逐機會，在餘下途程上未被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Unable to slot in, caught 3-wide in midfield, failed to make progress on leaders in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 未能切入，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W4W6W) Jumped only fairly, raced keenly and refused to settle due to the pace being run outside of standard time, improved his position on outside passing 800M but was left without a finishing effort in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W4W6W) 出閘僅屬一般。由於賽事步速較標準時間為慢，搶口及不願穩定走勢。跑過八百米處時沿外疊追前，但在直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Travelled 3-wide in 8th in rear of midfield, commenced move making home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on under pressure without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後第八位，走第三疊。轉直路彎時開始上前，入直路時移出最外疊。在催策下上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, unable to pick up for pressure from 500m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, not enough room early in straight, cleared 300M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，失去平衡，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初空位不足。三百米處望空。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W3W) Settled in midfield 2-wide, responded well early straight when asked, kept chasing to obtain the lead nearing 100M and just held off fast-finishing 2nd for a gutsy win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路初對催策反應良佳。持續追趕對手，接近一百米處時取得領先。末段在奮勇力拼下力拒衝刺強勁的亞軍馬匹僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至三百米處。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, angled out early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走內疊。直路彎沿欄略為追近。直路早段向外移出，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced behind midfield on outer, 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 500M, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後五個馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Dropped away from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走大外疊。最後二百米以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide approaching 550M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近五百五十米處時走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Blundered start and bumped, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 5 lengths back, same margin back on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時失蹄及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W7W) In rear after awkward start and lost balance, raced wide throughout, bumped 450m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W7W) 出閘笨拙及失去平衡，居後列。沿途走外疊。四百五十米處發生碰撞。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear without cover, some headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。直路上持續追前。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Fast into stride, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, hit the front approaching 300M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。趨近三百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺強勁，以一頸位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid-field, pushed along on bend to hold position, headway when checked briefly 250m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎受推策以保持位置。追前，二百五十米處一度勒避。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Raced in touch with leaders out wide, pushed along wide into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths back on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 500M, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Away well, raced in midfield on the outside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 550m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, pushed along to chase leader 500m out, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。五百米處受推策以追趕領放馬。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, found rail near 800M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近八百米處時移入內欄。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, made minor progress early in straight,
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路早段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, held up, clear run up rail home straight, one paced under pressure, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留後。直路上沿欄望空。在催策下保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, had to wait for run early in home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。直路早段須等待空位出現。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after leaving stalls, rear of mid-field, driven 500m out, briefly tight for room 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘後不久被碰撞，居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。三百米處一度受緊迫。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off strongly to snatch victory near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。二百米處望空。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider from 600M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走較外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, challenged up rail early in home straight, stayed on but no match for leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初沿欄展開挑戰。保持走勢，但不敵領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Soon dropped to last, checked 750M out, saved ground on rail turning in for home, producing good late impression inside final 200M when steadied about 70M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即墮居包尾位置。七百五十米處勒避。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。最後二百米追前甚多。約七十米處收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well and raced in a share of lead, ridden and opened up clear advantage from 300m out, just kept up to work final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，並排領先。自三百米處起受催策及拋離對手。最後五十米僅保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Average to begin, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along 400m out to chase leaders, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickened early to lead 350m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。率先加速，三百五十米處取得領先。走勢良佳，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight, won by 2-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以兩個半馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked leader on inside, came with a strong looking challenge 250M, tried hard but was always held by the winner. (Jockey - given the option of obtaining cover if circumstances permitted.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內疊。二百五十米處以勁勢上前挑戰。力拼，但一直落後頭馬。（騎師表示，他獲指示可選擇在情況許可下讓坐騎取得遮擋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Began well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival from 650M, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 100M, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。自六百五十米處起與對手並排領先。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百米未能抗衡頭馬，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, pushed along into home straight, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leader, pushed along to challenge leader top of home straight, gave ground final 150m.
(Blood in trachea and roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初受推策，挑戰領放馬。最後一百五十米墮退。
（氣管有血及再次患有喘鳴症。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （氣管有血及再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along 500m out, briefly hampered 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受推策。二百米處一度受阻礙。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, pushed along to chase leader 500m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受推策以追趕領放馬。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, pushed along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge, no extra final 200m.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策。未能增速以展開挑戰。最後二百米再無餘力。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide, 1-1/2L back, there to turn, hit the front 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後一個半馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後七十五米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W5W) Broke well from a poor draw, well there before taken back to joint 5th 2-wide near midfield, shifted wider turning in for home, ran on under pressure to hit the front over 100M despite hanging and a difficult ride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W5W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居好位，其後留居接近中間位置，並列第五位，走第二疊。轉入直路時移出較外疊。雖然內閃及難以策騎，但在催策下上前，一百米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, held up behind midfield, swung wide from 500M, kept on steadily to the line without posing serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置。自五百米處起移出外疊。保持穩勢至終點，未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced slightly better than midfield, no cover throughout, 1-3/4L back turning in, finished off very strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後一又四分三馬位。衝刺凌厲，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Began awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered to just worse than midfield mostly in 9th on rail, travelled keenly home bend and forced to steady 600M out, not much room early in straight, obtained a clear run 260M out, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，大多居中間稍後的第九位，走內欄。直路彎搶口，六百米處被迫收慢。直路早段空位不足，二百六十米處望空，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, 6 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後約六個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to make frame, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列競跑，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly from draw 1, settled down in midfield about 3Ls off pace, kept on one paced in the straight. Never a serious threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。直路上保持同速。從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Crowded start, positioned 4-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, same margin back on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步時受擠迫，落後領放馬四個半馬位，走內疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Began only fairly, settled towards the rear of the main group 4Ls off the pace, responded moderately final 300M, was making some progress on leaders but couldn't be ridden out late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居主馬群後列，落後領放馬四個馬位。最後三百米對催策反應普通，略為追近領先馬匹，但末段未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, towards rear, had to wait for run between 400m out and 300m out, stayed on, nearly got up for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。四百米處至三百米處之間須等待空位出現。保持穩勢，幾乎跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out 450M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders out wide, stayed in contention until no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。保持爭逐機會，直至最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, forced to steady on heels 800m out, switched inside for clear run 300m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。三百米處移入內疊以望空。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, pressed by runner-up but stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先。末段被亞軍馬匹追迫，但保持佳勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W2W) In rear when checked and dropped to joint last on 1000M bend, saved ground on the inside turning for home, obtained a clear run over 150M out and finished off the race well.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居後列，勒避。一千米處彎位墮退，並列包尾位置。轉直路彎時走內疊節省腳程。一百五十米處望空，衝刺良佳。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Rushed forward and crossed to the lead 750M, fought hard early straight trying to hold on for the lead, headed near 150M before fading away late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策上前，七百五十米處切入領放。直路早段力拼，嘗試保持領先。接近一百五十米處時被超越。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well until 100M, peaked and headed 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位，保持佳勢至一百米處。五十米處未能再增速及被超越，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Fast break, made all, kicked and quickened early in home straight, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭競跑。直路初加速，帶離對手。末段領先距離收窄，但保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, pressed in front, headed 300m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受催策，取得領先。在領放下受追迫。三百米處被超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast break, made running, pressed by runner-up throughout, headed 350m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭競跑。沿途被亞軍馬匹追迫。三百五十米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader on rail, same position on turn, kept on well until 150M, weakened 100M, eased closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位，走內欄。直路彎居相同位置。保持佳勢直至一百五十米處，一百米處轉弱，末段收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, set strong pace, headed by winner 250m out, sticking to task, just lost third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先，以快步速領放。二百五十米處被頭馬超越。末段持續力拼，僅失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Emerged as leader passing 1300M, took them along at good pace middle stages, still going well passing 400M then kept on strongly final stages under big weight to hold pursuing rivals at bay. Won 4 from 4.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跑過千三米處時取得領先。中段以快步速領放。跑過四百米處時仍保持佳勢。末段在負重磅下保持勁勢，力拒緊追的對手掄元。迄今四戰四勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, keen early stages, three lengths clear 800m out, margin reduced turning into home straight, quickened early in home straight and soon in command.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，領放。早段搶口。八百米處帶離三個馬位。轉入直路時領先距離收窄。直路初加速，瞬即控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on strongly in straight, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持勁勢。輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped on jumping, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead near 900M, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時被碰撞，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Caught wide early from draw 10 before obtaining a prominent spot outside leader 700M out, fought hard in the straight vying for the lead, kept on well to the line only beaten narrowly by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘，早段走外疊。七百米處佔取領放馬外側的前列位置。直路上力拼，爭奪領先。末段保持佳勢，僅以短距離之差不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leading pair, impeded briefly 200m out when trying to make effort, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處嘗試發力時一度受阻。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。三百五十米處加速。末段以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Chased leader, didn't travel with much fluency, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走勢欠順。直路初受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made all, pressed in front, responded well when pressed on 300m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 一放到底。在領放下受追迫。三百米處在催策下反應良佳。保持佳勢，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Clean jump, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, took the lead approaching 250M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘俐落，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。趨近二百五十米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Showed good speed to lead 2 off the outside rail, kept on nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;前速甚快，取得領先，走外欄第三疊。保持佳勢，僅保住平頭冠軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W1W) Waited with towards rear, driven along 350m out, crowded 200m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處受催策。二百米處受擠迫。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, stayed on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。末段保持勁勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, made good progress thereafter to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能望空。趨近二百米處時望空。其後追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Settled towards the rear, had some work to do top of the straight, held up 350M then hit the line well to claim 3rd. Encouraging run after lengthy break.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。直路初落後頗遠。三百五十米處受困，其後以佳勢衝刺，跑獲季軍。久休復出，表現令人鼓舞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Mid-field, briefly had to wait for run 400m out, headway after, stayed on at the one pace final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處一度須等待空位，其後上前。最後二百米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled towards the rear, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled midfield on the rail, travelled a bit keen, closed off well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。略為搶口。衝刺良佳，取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Disputed lead, unable to match winner from 300m line but stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先。自三百米處起未能追上頭馬，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tended to hang out throughout, forced to steady on heels 700m out, lost touch final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。沿途傾向外閃。七百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Controlled the tempo up front after a quick getaway, fought bravely final stages only fell short to a classy horse.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，其後上前，主宰步速。末段奮勇力拼，僅負於實力強勁的一駒，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Went for the lead on jumping from draw 11, crossed to the fence 800M and led steadily, was strongly challenged by rival final 250M but kept going well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後上前帶頭。八百米處切入內欄，以平穩步速領放。最後二百五十米受對手以勁勢挑戰，但保持佳勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well in front early stages, gradually taken one back on rail about 1000M out, came to challenge inside the 300M holding some chance but found winner to good.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段領先。約一千米處逐漸留後一個馬位，走內欄。三百米處展開挑戰，頗具勝望，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Amongst leaders, gradually shifted some 2L back to 4th one-out-one-back rounding home bend, kept on steadily without threatening in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居領先馬群中，逐漸留後約兩個馬位。轉直路彎時居第二疊第二位，即馬群中的第四位。直路上保持穩勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Went forward tracking the pace on the stand's side, kept up with leaders from 400M, raced tight along the fence and had difficulty obtaining clear running between 150M-50M. Held by leaders final stages.
(Sustained an abrasion to the right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to the right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;沿外欄上前跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起持續追趕領先馬匹。沿外欄緊迫競跑，一百五十米處至五十米處之間難以望空，末段未能追上領先馬匹。
（右前腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run early in straight, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, mid division, shifted right in home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居中間位置。直路上向內斜跑。未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Crowded at start, wide in midfield early stages, gained 4th within 3L of pace 600M out, ran on under pressure in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫。早段居中間位置，走外疊。六百米處進佔第四位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。直路上在催策下追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat just behind the speed 2 off the stands' rail, closed off nicely, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居領放馬稍後位置，走外欄第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Sat towards the rear center track, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)居後列，在跑道中央競跑。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced in midfield on the outside, 2-1/4L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後二又四分一個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, blocked off when going for run 350m out, clear run 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處取位時受困。三百米處望空，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after passing 400M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。跑過四百米處後向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, found daylight near 200M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百米處時望空，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the outside, similar position on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back, there to turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Blundered after the start, settled towards the rear, 5Ls to make up 400M, stayed on steadily to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後失蹄，居後列。四百米處落後五個馬位。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along into home straight, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，碰撞對手，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, switched and driven along to chase leaders 500m out, ran on well and just lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線及受催策以追趕領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，僅失亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, taken wider on bend, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, on top from there, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出較外疊。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。其後帶返終點，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped fairly, settled further back than intended in second half of the field, raced 3-wide without cover before closing off mildly final 300M. Not reached leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘一般，居較預期為後的後半馬群之中，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米衝刺一般。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, restrained to race behind midfield, taken out to a 3-wide spot 600M, kept on steadily final 400M for 3rd but was no threat to the runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，受約束，居中間之後位置。六百米處向外移至第三疊。最後四百米保持穩勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅遙遙領先的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from 400m out, closed on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, under pressure 400m out, headed 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 前速甚快，取得領先。四百米處受催策。二百米處被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, travelled strongly to lead early in home straight, pressed on 250m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初走勢強勁，取得領先。二百五十米處受催策。一百米處被頭馬超越，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well, positioned 1 out 1 back, there to turn, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居第二疊第二位。直路彎前居相同位置，二百五十米處取得領先，末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away well to lead, set good pace in first half of the race, shifted away from running rail on straightening then kept on well only to be caught by first three in closing stages. (Riding tactics questioned.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，領放。前半程以快步速領放。入直路時移離內欄，其後保持佳勢，僅於末段被三甲馬匹超越。（騎師被查詢競跑策略。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, challenged the leader early in straight, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段挑戰領放馬。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Soon led, made all setting a sound pace, ridden clear over 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 瞬即帶頭，以快步速領放。二百米處在催策下帶離對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Pressed forward to share early pace, obtained 1L advantage 1000M out, led until caught over 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前，早段並排領先。一千米處領先一個馬位。保持領先，直至一百米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, ran on well to lead 200m out, headed close home, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先。接近終點時被超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, raced very wide throughout, detached in home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。沿途走大外疊。直路上被拋離。大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, 2 wide after passing 900M, still well back on turn, weakened early in straight, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走內疊。跑過九百米處後走第二疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路初轉弱。包尾大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position on bend, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置。二百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the inside, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走內疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策毫無反應，最後二百米轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Settled ahead of midfield, steadied when crowded near 900M then raced keenly for some distance, lacked a finishing response in the straight. Never a serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置。接近九百米處時在受擠迫之際收慢，其後在一段途程上搶口。直路上在催策下衝刺乏力。從未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Began only fairly, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, checked near 1200M, steadied off heels near 900M, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近千二米處時勒避。接近九百米處時收慢避開他駒後蹄。入直路時走大外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, in midfield along the fence early stages, moved within striking distance home turn, loomed behind leaders mid-straight before proving too strong near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，早段居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎落後領放馬不遠。直路中段追至領先馬匹之後位置，接近終點時以勁勢超越對手，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 200M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Reserved behind midfield along the inside, chased steadily from 400M without threatening first two but wasn't far off 3rd and 4th. Encouraging debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。自四百米處起以穩勢追前，未能威脅首兩名馬匹，但落後季軍及第四名馬匹不遠。初出表現令人鼓舞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Four wide in rear of mid-field without cover, ridden along 400m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。末段保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W4W) Crowded at start, raced very wide in rear, under pressure 600m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走大外疊。六百米處受催策。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時落後約四個馬位，末段衝刺良佳，取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow(-) (2W4W) On the back foot after badly squeezed shortly after the start, niggled throughout to stay attached, took a while to get into stride over final stages and won impressively from last.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速(-)(2W4W) 起步後不久嚴重受擠迫，居包尾位置。沿途在催策下跟隨馬群。末段加速需時，自包尾位置取勝，姿態出色。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, easy run to turn, showed good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, followed winner through top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米衝刺強勁，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced in 3rd, 1-1/2L back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居第三位。入直路時落後一個半馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先，保持勁勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。二百米處望空，末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, commenced move 650M, 3 wide turning in, took the lead 300M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。六百五十米處開始上前。入直路時走第三疊，三百米處取得領先，保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout, mid division, pushed along 500m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，沿途走大外疊。五百米處受推策。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Awkward start and lost ground, recovered to settle rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 600m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處移離內欄。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Away well from the inside draw and trailed the leader, finished off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自內檔出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬。衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Tracked leaders out wide with cover, good headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，有遮擋。直路彎以佳勢追前。直路上持續追前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) From draw 2 stayed close to the pace early on before drifting back to race in midfield middle stages, ran home well final 300M for 3rd beaten only 0.5L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，早段居接近領放馬的位置。中段墮居中間位置。最後三百米衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，僅負半個馬位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W5W) Settled in rear of mid-field, good headway on bend, switched widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 300m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W5W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎以佳勢上前。入直路時移出最外疊。最後三百米走勢強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, followed winner through 200m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W1W1W) 沿欄居中間位置。入直路時須等待空位出現。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前。走勢良佳，僅負短距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Settled well behind and waited with, baulked for a run early in straight until over 250M out, quickened well to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 遙居後列，留力候上。直路早段受困至二百五十米處。末段加速良佳，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W3W) Settled in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Went forward as expected and led steadily to the home straight, kept to the task from 300M, lost lead nearing 150M and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘後如預期般上前。以平穩步速領放至直路。自三百米處起保持走勢。接近一百五十米處時被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Set strong pace, pressed in front, headed top of home straight, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 以快步速領放，在領放下受追迫。直路初被超越。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, two lengths clear 600m out, three lengths clear into home straight, weakened quickly and headed by winner 150m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。六百米處帶離兩個馬位。入直路時帶離三個馬位。迅速轉弱。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made all, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 領放。二百米處加速帶離對手兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped well, raced prominently on the middle track, peaked on run approaching 350M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居前列，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百五十米處時未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Soon took up running on the rail setting a sound pace, angled out on straightening and hung on well under pressure in front until swamped final few strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，以快步速領放，走內欄。入直路時向外移出。在領放下受催策時保持佳勢，直至最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Made all, showed good speed to get across, kicked 300m out, in control final 100m, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 領放，展現甚快前速以切入。三百米處加速。最後一百米控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running from stall 1, controlled race from front, led by 2L+ into home straight, ran on strongly to extend advantage.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後帶頭，在領放下主宰步速。入直路時領先逾兩個馬位。末段走勢強勁，擴大領先優勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled toward rear, pulled forward slightly before steadied when keen about 950M out, saved ground on the inside turning in for home but did not find much room early in straight until the 200M, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，其後略為追前。約九百五十米處搶口時收慢。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程，但直路初空位不足直至二百米處。其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W4W) Very slowly away losing considerable ground, recovered steadily to join the rear of the field over 900M out, commenced move angling off the rail 600M out, ran on from 4L 9th into straight to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W4W) 出閘十分緩慢，失地甚多。其後逐漸恢復走勢，九百米處追上馬群後列。六百米處移離內欄，開始上前。入直路時落後四個馬位，居第九位，其後追前，過終點時僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, moved closer after passing 1200M, no cover from 900M, 1 to 2 lengths back on turn, hard ridden approaching 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。跑過千二米處後追近。自九百米處起沒有遮擋。直路彎落後一至兩個馬位。趨近三百米處時受力策，但反應僅屬一般。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, made contact near 600M, same position on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。接近六百米處時與對手互相觸碰。直路彎居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Crowded at start and soon taken across at the back for rails run, travelled keenly on heels from the 600M, obtained a clear run switching onto inside 300M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 起步時受擠迫，瞬即在馬群之後切入內欄。自六百米處起搶口，緊貼他駒後蹄。三百米處移向內疊以望空。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W6W) Dropped out from wide draw without cover, taken widest into home straight, short-lived effort 300m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W6W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，沒有遮擋。入直路時移出最外疊。三百米處一度發力。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Waited with in rear, ridden top of home straight, tight for room 200m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策。二百米處受緊迫，從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Held up, dropped to last pair into home straight, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留後。入直路時墮居最後兩位之內。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Chased leaders early before sitting back in midfield, held up for clear running 400M to 300M then ran home mildly when asked. Not ridden out late stages when held up again.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段追趕領先馬匹，其後居中間位置。四百米處至三百米處之間受困而未能望空。直路上受催策時走勢普通。末段在再度受困之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back to last few from a wide barrier and waited with, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, produced good late impression inside final 250M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居最後數位之內，留力候上。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後二百五十米追前甚多。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, still well back on turn, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘， 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上超越一些已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Taken across from a wide draw, settled near last throughout the event, had some work to do top of straight but couldn't pick up speed when needed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後切入。沿途居接近包尾位置。直路初落後甚遠，但於關鍵時刻未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Bumped out of stalls, settled in mid-field, bumped 450m out and taken wider into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。四百五十米處被碰撞，入直路時被帶出較外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, not best of runs 400m out to 200m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處至二百米處之間未能完全望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover in the middle stages, peaked on run 500M, weakened gradually in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。五百米處未能再增速。直路上逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout in rear of mid-field, some headway on bend, forced to steady 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，沿途走大外疊。直路彎略為追前。一百米處被迫收慢，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled handy, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Blundered at the Start, sat rear, badly held up in the Straight until 100M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時失蹄，居後列。直路上嚴重受困直至一百米處。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, same margin back on turn, angled out early in straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路初向外移出。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W4W) Badly crowded and checked shortly after start, shuffled back, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W4W) 起步後不久嚴重受擠迫及勒避，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Away with them, raced towards rear on the inside, steadied off heels near 650M, 2 wide from 600M, very wide into straight, made contact early in straight, failed to make any progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走內疊。接近六百五十米處時收慢避開他駒後蹄。自六百米處起走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路初與對手互相觸碰。其後未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted in shortly after start and made contact, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久向內斜跑及發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, showed good response early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Moderately away, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, similar position on turn, kept on well in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎位置相若。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Stayed prominent to the pace in early and middle stages, came under serious pressure 500M, dropped away quickly on straightening.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 早段及中段居前列位置。五百米處受力策。入直路時迅速墮退。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders throughout, in 5th spot from 800M, had his chance but ran home only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 沿途保持落後領先馬匹不遠。自八百米處起居第五位。已獲機會盡展所長，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out 550M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出，入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Restrained from wide draw and keen. Short-lived headway 400m out and soon flattened out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，受約束及搶口。四百米處一度追前，但瞬即洩氣。
